name: system_one_burst_workload

test_list.description: With exact installed artifacts, measure actual authenticated repeated-input warm/post-eviction bursts and a 50-distinct-input warm round; successful transport is not a semantic quality verdict.
Every request has one actual recorded outcome and timing under bounded owned concurrency.
Stalled calls yield timeout outcomes without fabricated decisions.
Cancellation aborts and joins owned work before reporting.
Missing or foreign question identities are not successful decisions.

inputs.name: requests
inputs.description: Actual bounded schemas and masked inputs.

output_description: Sanitized per-request outcomes and observed latency quantiles; quality and recovery require separate evidence.
